reason: This is the 63rd Annual Report of HFCL Infotel Limited for fiscal year ending March 31, 2010. The document contains corporate governance information, financial statements, directors' reports, and auditors' reports. However, it does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures for the company's telecommunications services business (fixed line, CDMA mobile, broadband DSL, or GSM services). The company discusses operational metrics like subscriber counts (87,354 broadband DSL subscribers, 259,456 CDMA customers) and revenue figures (telecom service revenue of Rs. 1,962.09 million), but no market size or TAM data is provided anywhere in the filing.
